memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: New diagnosis, symptomatic fatigue.
  - Plan: Start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, check weight and waist, diet advice.
- Weight: 58 kg
- Waist: 70 cm (female, <80 cm OK).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – include fortified cereal and orange juice; Lunch – leafy greens with lentils; Dinner – lean protein with vegetables.
- Due: Next B12 check in 3 months (2025-07-10).
